name: Mahjong Arcade
author: PointNet Games
description: Mahjong Solitaire with dual Arcade and Classic modes: 330 progressive levels with 4 rotating 144-tile Classic Boss challenges, standalone Free Classic Mode with 4 iconic 144-tile boards (Turtle, Ziggurat, Imperial Fortress, Spider), Shield Wards, Conveyor Rings and standalone Zen Jukebox. Mobile-first, 100% solvable.
instructions: Tap a free tile to send it to the staging box. Two matching tiles in the box disappear. 4 tiles without a match = game over. Face-down tiles reveal their symbol on tap, then go to staging on second tap. Drag tiles to peek underneath.
